config.expected_if_true: Final N=64 trained force R2 >= 0.721 (seed 22) and >= 0.736 (seed 23), i.e. at least 0.04 above the same seed's N=128 6000-step value, in both seeds. accel_step normalised margin in [0.60, 0.85].
config.hypothesis: With m2 fixed at 0.5 and both arms trained for the same 6000 steps, the N=64 minus N=128 gap in trained force R2 persists for fresh seeds 22-23 on data_seed 0. The N=128 6000-step references are 0.681 (seed 22, layer 4) and 0.696 (seed 23, layer 1). Values are read from probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded, and the layer is reported. If the best layers differ between arms, the comparison is flagged as cross-layer. Horizon check: step-3000 trained force R2 (same-layer control plus margin) must be within 0.03 of the 3000-step N=64 m2-fixed runs (0.767 / 0.770); otherwise the result is reported as horizon-confounded.
